en.name: Sinful Spoils of Doom - Rciela (Rush Duel)
en.effect: Choose 1 face-up Level 7 or higher Spellcaster Type monster on your field. That monster cannot be destroyed by your opponent's card effects until the end of your opponent's next turn. Then, you can choose up to 3 face-up monsters with 100 or more ATK on your opponent's field. While those opponent's monsters are face-up, they lose ATK equal to [the ATK of your chosen monster]. Monsters whose ATK becomes 0 by this effect are destroyed.
